Flautist Kent Jordan is making his contribution to jazz as a performer and educator. He graduated from the Eastman School of Music in 1984 and has taught at the New Orleans Center for the Creative Arts. Kent has recorded as a leader of his own group and has shared the stage with Nicholas Payton, Wynton Marsalis, Kevin Eubanks and with members of his own musical family, including his father, saxophonist Kidd Jordan.
Kent was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 22, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Rome, New York with Kent Jordan. Thanks for being here.
I’m glad to be here. This is an honor and a privilege, it really is.
